title: Name of man killed in gunfight with Fort McMurray RCMP released
article: The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team has released the name of a man killed in a shooting in northern Alberta that also left a rookie RCMP officer injured.
Ahmad Abdallah, 24, was killed in the gunfight, said ASIRT spokesman Clifton Purvis. The organization is not releasing the cause of death.
On March 17, Fort McMurray RCMP responded to a call about a man armed with a gun at a Macdonald Avenue apartment building.

A gunfight between three RCMP officers and the male suspect began almost immediately after officers entered the building. The man died at the scene and a female officer was shot in the abdomen. She remains in hospital in stable condition.
The wounded officer did not fire the shot that killed the suspect. She had 10 months experience with the RCMP.
Of the three officers involved in the gunfight, the most senior had five years experience and the second had two, Purvis said last week.
The investigation into the shooting is ongoing.
